description: This file defines the Git::SVN package, implementing SVN repository interactions, including remote configuration, revision parsing, fetching, property walking, commit management, and URL handling within a Perl-based Git extension for SVN.

classes.name: Git::SVN
classes.description: Main class providing SVN repository interaction, configuration, property management, revision handling, and commit operations within a Perl extension for Git.

methods.name: resolve_local_globs
methods.description: Resolves local glob references in SVN refs to fetch paths, handling conflicts and metadata validation.

methods.name: parse_revision_argument
methods.description: Parses revision arguments, supporting various formats like numeric, range, and special keywords.

methods.name: fetch_all
methods.description: Fetches all revisions from remote SVN repositories based on configuration and revision ranges.

methods.name: read_all_remotes
methods.description: Reads and parses all remote SVN repository configurations.

methods.name: init_vars
methods.description: Initializes internal variables related to garbage collection intervals.

methods.name: verify_remotes_sanity
methods.description: Checks for configuration conflicts in remote refs to prevent ambiguous tracking.

methods.name: find_existing_remote
methods.description: Finds existing remote repository configuration matching a URL to avoid duplication.

methods.name: init_remote_config
methods.description: Initializes remote repository configuration, handling URL minimization and existing entries.

methods.name: find_by_url
methods.description: Locates a remote SVN repository configuration matching a given URL and optional path.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Constructs a new Git::SVN object, optionally initializing remote configuration.

methods.name: find_ref
methods.description: Finds remote configuration references matching a given ref ID.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new Git::SVN object, resolving configuration and repository details.

methods.name: refname
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates SVN ref names for use in Git.

methods.name: desanitize_refname
methods.description: Decodes URL-encoded SVN ref names back to their original form.

methods.name: svm_uuid
methods.description: Retrieves the SVM UUID, either cached or by remote call.

methods.name: svm
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the SVM configuration for the repository.

methods.name: ra_uuid
methods.description: Memoizes and retrieves the SVN repository UUID.

methods.name: repos_root
methods.description: Gets or sets the repository root URL in configuration.

methods.name: ra
methods.description: Creates and returns an SVN::Ra object for repository interaction, handling SVM and metadata.

methods.name: prop_walk
methods.description: Recursively traverses SVN directory properties, invoking a callback on directories with properties.

methods.name: last_rev
methods.description: Returns the latest SVN revision number.

methods.name: last_commit
methods.description: Returns the latest commit SHA1.

methods.name: last_rev_commit
methods.description: Returns the newest SVN revision number and commit SHA1.

methods.name: get_fetch_range
methods.description: Calculates the range of revisions to fetch based on current state.

methods.name: svn_dir
methods.description: Returns the SVN directory path within the Git repository.

methods.name: tmp_config
methods.description: Temporarily modifies Git configuration for SVN operations.

methods.name: tmp_index_do
methods.description: Performs operations with a temporary Git index file.

methods.name: assert_index_clean
methods.description: Ensures the Git index matches a specific treeish state.

methods.name: get_commit_parents
methods.description: Determines parent commits for a given log entry, including injected parents.

methods.name: rewrite_root
methods.description: Retrieves or sets the repository URL rewrite root.

methods.name: rewrite_uuid
methods.description: Retrieves or sets the repository UUID rewrite.

methods.name: metadata_url
methods.description: Constructs the URL for repository metadata, considering rewrite rules.

methods.name: full_url
methods.description: Returns the full URL of the repository including path.

methods.name: full_pushurl
methods.description: Returns the push URL, considering optional push URL configuration.

methods.name: set_commit_header_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables for commit author and date based on log entry.

methods.name: restore_commit_header_env
methods.description: Restores environment variables after commit.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection in Git.

methods.name: do_git_commit
methods.description: Creates a Git commit from SVN log entry, managing revision mapping and environment.

methods.name: match_paths
methods.description: Checks if the current path matches specified path patterns.

methods.name: find_parent_branch
methods.description: Finds the parent branch of the current SVN path based on revision history.
